### God-Breathed Scripture
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-breathed-scripture
Passage: 2 Timothy 3:16
Points:
- Paul's description of Scripture as breathed out indicates it is God's actual speech.
- The Bible alone possesses the unique status of being divinely inspired.
- God communicated His authoritative revelation through the personalities and styles of human authors.
- Verbal plenary inspiration means every word of Scripture is given by God and entirely trustworthy.
- Believers should look to the Bible as their sole authoritative guide for discovering God's will.

### Are You Listening to the Word of God?
Author: Adrian Rogers (Love Worth Finding)
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-october-14-2024.html
Passage: 2 Timothy 3:16-17
Points:
- Just as human speech requires expelled breath, Scripture is the breath of God made audible.
- Reading the Bible is encountering the living voice of God speaking directly to us.
- Scripture demands special reverence because its words proceed directly from the Lord.
- Christians should depend upon and nourish their spiritual lives with God's Word every day.
